meta.title: Sayd Social Club — Afro-Caribbean nights in Québec City
meta.description: Premium Afro-Caribbean parties and day parties in Québec City since 2019. Tickets online.

home.noEvent: The next party will be announced soon. Follow us on Instagram to hear first.
home.manifesto: We throw the parties we wished Québec City had: Afro-Caribbean music, well-dressed people and a venue chosen with care.
home.radioText: The music from our nights, in a playlist updated all season.
home.ambassadorsText: Know people, love our parties? Represent Sayd in your circle and get perks at every event.
home.galleryEmpty: Photos from the season are coming after the next party.
home.galleryNote: Music, elegance and good company: the spirit of our nights.
home.heroLine: Where Afro-Caribbean culture meets contemporary luxury.

pillars.d: Afrobeats, amapiano, dancehall and house, from DJs who know how to read a room.
A dress code for every edition. We dress up, we recognise each other.
A social circle where connections are made, night after night.

about.title: The club
about.lead: Sayd Social Club has been throwing premium parties and day parties in Québec City since 2019, for a 25–35 crowd.
about.body: Our mission: build a real premium Afro-Caribbean scene in Québec City. Afrobeats, amapiano, dancehall, house, venues chosen for the occasion and a dress code for every edition.
